new_public_evidence.source: Mineiro, A lower confidence sequence for the changing mean of non-negative right heavy-tailed observations with bounded mean
new_public_evidence.result: Heavy-NSM constructions allow fixed/predeclared lambda mixtures while preserving time-uniform validity for changing conditional means.

new_public_evidence.source: V'yugin, Online Aggregation of Unbounded Signed Losses Using Shifting Experts
new_public_evidence.result: A variable-rate Mixing Past Posteriors/AdaHedge theorem exists for shifting experts, but its generic finite-sample constants are numerically far too loose for the current ~200-300 informative-event regime.

derived_results.claim: For fixed lambda_j<1 and prior pi_j, K_j,t=product_s(1-lambda_j d_s/w) can be mixed into one supermartingale. The anytime upper CS is the unique U_t solving sum_j pi_j K_j,t exp(lambda_j t U_t/w)=1/alpha. This gives adaptation over betting strengths without validation-stream retuning.

A uniform predeclared lambda mixture {0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,0.95} was valid but slower than the frozen lambda=0.95 on 300 fresh recurring synthetic runs: certification 95.33% vs 97.0%, median 23,255 vs 18,272 and q90 67,791.5 vs 63,072. More adaptive in principle did not improve finite-sample power here.

In 150 gradual-drift synthetic runs, the r117 cumulative CS certified all runs and remained certified even after the instantaneous weighted gap became persistently positive at median raw time 71,667. The true cumulative weighted gap still remained strongly negative, so this is a semantic mismatch rather than a theorem failure: cumulative safety is not current-regime safety.

The late instantaneous positive weighted gap in the gradual stress was tiny (median 1.53e-6, mean 2.92e-6 normalized per sample). A current-regime detector should target a declared material harm threshold rather than every microscopic sign change.

For any q_epsilon=epsilon W+(1-epsilon)q0 family with epsilon in [e,1], loss normalization B=1/e^2 and the paired normalized gap versus base has the tight range d in [-e^2/4,1-e], width (2-e)^2/4. The defensive floor therefore jointly controls maximum importance weight, bounded online loss and statistical certification range.

On fresh recurring synthetic lineages with three-point grids {e,(1+e)/2,1}, e=0.8 certified much faster (100%, median 10,555.5) than e=0.6 (98%, median 17,484) but had less variance reduction (mean variance 190.37 vs 188.04; base 199.6). e=0.4 was dominated under this noisy proxy. The floor is a multiobjective design variable, not merely an aggressiveness knob.

The cited MPP/AdaHedge shifting theorem is real, but with T≈235, N=3, k=3 its generic additive term alone is about 1,192.8 normalized loss, or ~3,313 variance units after B=25/9, vastly larger than the complete ~188-200 synthetic variance budget. Keep its conceptual precedent separate from a usable numeric certificate.

engineering_update.scope: All numeric power/variance results are synthetic engineering evidence. The lambda-mixture supermartingale formula and general epsilon-floor range are derived theorem-level statements within the stated bounded adaptive-proposal model.

negative_or_scope_evidence: A valid lambda mixture can be slower than a well-chosen fixed bet; do not add adaptivity without measured value.
Cumulative-average certification must not be relabeled as recent/current safety after drift.
Local routing should use a material harm tolerance; microscopic positive gaps need not justify fallback.
The floor Pareto is synthetic and depends on proxy quality, candidate family and evidence budget.
Generic adversarial shifting-expert constants can be mathematically correct yet operationally vacuous at small rare-event sample sizes.
Dependent/systematic resampling, random counts, environment/tool transition proposal bias and real agent traces remain outside scope.
frontier: Define a declared current-regime materiality target in variance units and derive a separate routing detector with explicit global false-alarm accounting, while preserving r117's cumulative 5% CS unchanged.

Optimize the defensive floor jointly over expected estimator variance, certification delay and maximum importance ratio; seek a robust rule under proxy-quality uncertainty rather than one synthetic optimum.
Test whether low-fidelity proxy-drift signals can trigger reversible shrinkage toward base before sparse high-fidelity failures arrive, while never using the proxy as the truth certificate.
Seek a sharper adaptive-rate tracking theorem with finite-sample constants useful at ~200-300 informative events; otherwise retain fixed eta plus exact realized mixability accounting.
Extend the general floor/range and paired-CS derivation to dependent/systematic sibling resampling and random particle counts under proper weighting.
Only after trajectory semantics are theorem-clean, instantiate judge-guided proposal plus sparse high-fidelity truth on an agent benchmark.
exact_next_action: Choose an explicit local material-harm scale in raw normalized second-moment units and derive the simplest theorem-clean current-regime routing layer that does not spend/reuse the cumulative r117 alpha. Compare an e-detector/CUSUM route with preallocated alpha epochs, and quantify delay at harm levels large enough to matter in cumulative variance. In parallel derive a robust defensive-floor selection criterion that trades maximum weight 1/e, CS width (2-e)^2/4 and expected variance gain, then stress it across proxy noise instead of one regime.
